name: going camping
source:
Clover is sick of her life, but she won’t be for long! None of her issues matter once she wipes her memory and takes her robot girlfriend (she promises it isn’t as bad as it sounds) to the wilderness, away from society, where they’ll happily live out the rest of their days. Or will they…

[From [url=https://callalillie.itch.io/going-camping]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
克洛弗厌倦了她的生活，但她不会太久！一旦她抹去了她的记忆，并带着她的机器人女朋友（她保证这并不像听起来那么糟糕）到荒野，远离社会，她的所有问题都不再重要，在那里他们将幸福地度过余生。或者他们会……

[来自[url=https://callalillie.itch.io/going-camping]Itch.io[/url]]
